//! A production composition root that wires the FLOOR mock-crypto verifier as the default graph.
//! This is the SI-001..SI-004 shape: the `Structural*` verifier parses a plaintext pipe-delimited
//! string, so any principal/token is forgeable — and it is constructed in the PRODUCTION graph.
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Build the human/SSO authenticator over the S1 principal store (the `*_app_spec` default).
pub fn human_sso_app_spec(store: PrincipalStore) -> HumanSsoAuthenticator {
    // RED: the `Structural*` mock-crypto verifier is CONSTRUCTED in the production graph.
    HumanSsoAuthenticator::with_verifier(store, Arc::new(StructuralVerifier::new()))
}
